title: 14.22. Cittaduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Cittaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nocitto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … ekaṁ.
Nocittaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nanocitto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … tīṇi.
Cittañca nocittañca dhammaṁ paṭicca nocitto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (1) (Saṅkhittaṁ. Sabbattha pañca.)
